HANDOFF_SETTINGS.INDEX_DESCRIPTION: Pick the pipeline to set how the AI hands conversations to humans.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.POOL_SOURCE_NOTE: The rotation pool comes from the inbox where the conversation arrived. The inboxes above are the ones linked to this pipeline.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.DEFAULT_HELP: Applies to every stage without its own rule.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.ENABLE_STAGE: Hand off to a human at this stage
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.FLOW_DIRECT_DESC: Assigns right away and the AI stops answering.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.FLOW_INVITE_DESC: Notifies the agent and the AI keeps answering until someone picks it up.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.POOL_USER_DESC: The same person always receives it.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.ONLINE_HINT_DIRECT: Assigns only to someone online. With nobody online, it waits and tries again when someone comes online.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.ONLINE_HINT_INVITE: Prefers someone online, but invites even offline agents. The AI keeps answering.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.ACTION_RENOTIFY_DESC: Pings the invited agent again, up to 8 times.
HANDOFF_SETTINGS.ACTION_ESCALATE_DESC: Assigns to a supervisor on duty.
